mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market slowdown indicated by UNRATE rising above 5.5% over the past 3 months increases equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and labor market growth (PAYEMS) indicate broad economic weakness that depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and PAYEMS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.5% sustained for 3 months), higher discount rates depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained retail sales growth (RSAFS above 6-month moving average) signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS > 6-month moving average, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing supply shock indicated by INDPRO falling below 100 for two consecutive months reduces industrial output and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE signal monetary tightening coinciding with labor market weakness, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market stress
failure_condition: The joint rise in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE fails to produce negative 5-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion (INDPRO > 105 for three consecutive months), strong industrial production supports earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during early-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
